newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco keeps bunker fuel prices flat.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco keeps bunker fuel prices flat.

text.p: Saudi Aramco said on Wednesday the price of its A-888 bunker diesel lifted from the Red Sea ports of Jeddah and Yanbu stood at $194 a tonne effective April 17, unchanged from last week's level.
A-888 from the Gulf ports of Ras Tanura and Dammam was also unchanged at $213 a tonne.
Aramco's weekly bunker price telex said the price of its A-960 bunker fuel oil from Ras Tanura and Dammam remained at $101 a tonne.
The price of its A-960 from the Red sea was also unchanged at $101 a tonne.
